label: Coauthored Elementary Particles article
description: Gell-Mann coauthored an article in Scientific American with E.P. Rosenbaum.

sources.quote:
In the summer of 1957, after a hard day's work as a
counselor at a day camp for children, I came across an article you coauthored
in Scientiﬁc American

label: Zweig arrives at Caltech
description: Zweig arrived at Caltech for graduate school following advice to study with Feynman and Gell-Mann.

sources.quote:
There are a couple of young guys
at Caltech, Feynman and Gell-Mann, why don't you go there.

label: Proposed SU(3) classification
description: Gell-Mann and Ne'eman independently proposed classifying hadronic resonances according to SU(3) representations.

sources.quote:
Murray and Yuval Ne'eman independently proposed
that these, and other hadronic resonances, be classiﬁed according to the
representations of SU(3)

label: Lunch with Bob Serber
description: Gell-Mann discussed SU(3) fundamental representations with Serber at Columbia faculty club.

sources.quote:
According to Bob Serber, in the spring of 1963
over lunch at the Columbia faculty club, Serber told Murray about a scheme
he had been thinking about

label: Published quark paper
description: Gell-Mann proposed using fractionally charged objects as fields in a toy field theory.

sources.quote:
in February of 1964 Mur-
ray proposed using the three fractionally charged objects in the fundamental
representation as ﬁelds from which to construct the currents of a toy ﬁeld
theory

label: Zweig explains aces to Gell-Mann
description: Zweig explained his concrete quark model (aces) to Gell-Mann, who dismissed it.

sources.quote:
When I went in to see Murray to
explain my ideas after returning from CERN in the early fall of 1964, he
exclaimed "Oh, the concrete quark model. That's for blockheads!"

label: Attempted Scientific American article
description: Gell-Mann and Zweig attempted to write a joint article on quarks but disagreed on meaning.

sources.quote:
In late 1971 he ﬂew Frank Bello, an associate editor, to Pasadena
to help Murray and me write an article on quarks

label: Delivered Schladming lectures
description: Gell-Mann delivered lectures titled 'Quarks' in Schladming, Austria.

sources.quote:
At the end of
February 1972, Murray
delivered a set of lectures in Schladming Austria titled "Quarks"

label: Feynman nominated Gell-Mann for Nobel
description: Feynman nominated both Gell-Mann and Zweig for the Nobel Prize in Physics.

sources.quote:
In 1977 Feynman nominated both of us for
the Nobel Prize in Physics.

label: Shifted to complexity and linguistics
description: Gell-Mann's work became less concerned with experiment, focusing on foundations, complexity, and linguistics.

sources.quote:
Murray worked on foun-
dations of quantum theory, then complexity and linguistics.
